title: Dr. Lemon's 80th Birthday!
description: Our church family has something special to celebrate! Following the morning service, we'll gather in the Fellowship Hall for cake in honor of Dr. Lemon's 80th birthday. Let's fill the Fellowship Hall and let Dr. Lemon known how much he is loved and appreciated.
location: Victory Baptist Church - 295 Pleasant View Drive, Kittanning, PA 16201
